item.subject: science
item.stem:
Aarav walks from his home to the bus stop, waits there, and then walks on to school. He covers 240 m in 120 s, stands still at the bus stop for 60 s, and then covers another 360 m in 120 s.

What is Aarav's average speed for the whole journey from home to school?

options.A: 2 m/s, because he walked 240 m in 120 s in the first part
options.B: 2 m/s, because the total distance of 600 m is divided by the total time of 300 s
options.C: 3 m/s, because 360 m divided by 120 s gives his fastest walking speed
options.D: 2.5 m/s, because the total distance of 600 m is divided by only the walking time of 240 s
